description: Ernemann于1925年推出的折叠相机。配备Ernemann Ernon 1:3.5/75mm or Carl Zeiss Jena Tessar 1:4.5/80mm。使用4.5×6cm film plates。lever at the lens: 3.6 feet to infinity。

specs.镜头: Ernemann Ernon 1:3.5/75mm or Carl Zeiss Jena Tessar 1:4.5/80mm
specs.对焦: lever at the lens: 3.6 feet to infinity
specs.光圈: Iris diaphragm, stoppable down to f32
specs.英文简介: The Ernemann Miniatur-Ernoflex was a miniature version of Ernemann's folding plate SLR cameras with focal plane shutter.
